test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'DARK' is written as 'ECSM' and 'TREE' is written as 'UTFG'. How will 'GAME' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2279c21b248cf244ce9c66a353413ffa1a01afa396a02423895bd343ac1e758.png] 

**DARK: ECSM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f07249da24b66ad515ca30e04e669f8f36f25d99ab1cc941fdc460f7d858a884.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6736caa1d21b550ff07b7ca5fee648626b8151e92df77f1443fa4ad4819917fc.png] 

**TREE: UTFG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82f615d93520762fc2dd92dcd49e28d389975f95f9b07a85921e90be31807f9e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3e1f5be2aca72aeda0174ed85e3ebc08603bafff458761a3d2e7e9f5691c90f.png] 

Similarly,

**GAME:?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a073addc622fad6ca2d04e7f3490644629c8f13a404f1cd0823047edb439be70.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbfc547ecec9641fd59000a707ec28660966b34f7846955d7bdf66acc200f9c0.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"HCNG"**.
